intent: New game textures for optional remastered graphics; original assets remain independent.

styleReference.direction: Grounded realistic coastal defense, muted khaki sand, olive vegetation, blue-grey sea, natural sky and restrained metallic response.

prompts.sand: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square game PBR base-color texture for a 4K Beach Head coastal defense remaster. Primary request: 2048x2048 production-ready orthographic top-down coastal sand, matching the grounded realistic material style of the referenced beachhead-2000-remake: muted khaki-tan and grey-beige, fine granular sand with subtle wind ripples, a few tiny salt-weathered pebbles, understated natural variation. Uniform diffuse overcast illumination, no directional shadows, no baked specular highlights or ambient vignette. Perfectly tileable left/right and top/bottom, even detail density across edges. A close view of roughly two meters of sand, crisp fine material detail. Fill entire image with texture. No perspective, horizon, plants, footprints, weapons, text, border, or watermark.
prompts.grass: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square game terrain PBR albedo tile for a 4K coastal military game. Primary request: 2048x2048 orthographic top-down weathered coastal ground with low sparse fine olive-green and straw grasses integrated into brown-grey sandy soil, small pebbles. Realistic but restrained PC game remaster style, muted natural palette; do not use saturated lawn green. The visible patch is roughly two meters wide, finely detailed, balanced mottling without large recognizable objects or dominant clumps. Uniform diffuse flat light, no cast shadows, no occlusion vignette, no directional lighting. Seamlessly tileable on all four edges. No sky, perspective, trees, flowers, signs, footprints, text, border or watermark.
prompts.rock: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square game PBR rock/concrete surface base-color tile. Primary request: 2048x2048 orthographic top-down fine weathered grey coastal sandstone and eroded concrete-like aggregate, for the grounded realistic visual style of a modern Beach Head remaster. Cool grey with subtle warm taupe mineral variation, fine pores and small natural cracks, restrained contrast suitable for large sloping terrain and bunker concrete. Roughly two meters of material, evenly spread microdetail, flat diffuse illumination without baked shadows or specular highlights. Seamless all four edges; entire canvas is the material. No big boulders, terrain perspective, moss clumps, objects, labels, border or watermark.
prompts.ocean: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square game water micro-surface color tile. Primary request: 2048x2048 orthographic straight-down ocean surface, muted blue-grey and subdued teal coastal water, small coherent wind-driven ripples with a few fine broken pale foam filaments. Grounded physically plausible PC coastal defense remaster style. Uniform overall intensity and very low-frequency contrast, dense subtle ripples, fine detail instead of giant wave crests. Seamlessly tileable on all four edges. No horizon, no seafloor, no beach, no boats, no coastline, no sunlight hotspot, no directional cast shadows, no text, no frame or watermark.
prompts.sky: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless 2:1 equirectangular 360 degree sky environment for a realistic coastal military game at 4K. Primary request: high resolution 3840x1920 panoramic maritime daytime environment. Longitude wraps seamlessly left to right; horizon exactly halfway vertically. Upper hemisphere: natural desaturated blue sky with soft detailed fair-weather cumulus clouds concentrated near the horizon, a few thin high clouds and roomy blue overhead, evenly lit without a visible sun disc. Lower hemisphere: subdued uniform blue-grey distant ocean gradually darkening toward nadir; no land or objects. Grounded 3D PC game remaster atmosphere, restrained contrast, slight coastal haze precisely at horizon. Clean continuous panorama, no cut-off clouds at longitude seam, no text, no frame, no watermark. This is a spherical environment map, not a perspective photograph or a game screenshot.
